text: GBP/USD drifted up through the killzone, only just tagged its Asia high and sits on its equilibrium. EUR/USD ran below its Asia low into the previous-day low area and closed back above it, with its equilibrium about 9 pips overhead. The two pairs disagree, one at its Asia high and the other through its Asia low, which is SMT.
